title: -  - Anna Erhard - One Minute of Silence

lines.l: All leaves came down in one day
And dressed our street in red
I crushed and pushed them away
To mute the things I couldn't say
While up and all around me
Their eyes are turning on me
I have this fear in my throat
Or closed your eyes, you're so polite
Oh no, now it's growing on me
so peacefully and all ears for me sweet times we're living in but so carefully all ears for me
